persons.name: Vakhāsiṃha
persons.evidence: dānapati ... turādharavakhāsiṃhayāmana saatidharmmacitte utpatijñasya o yā o śrī śrī rakṣā bhagavati pustaka vāvakā juro

persons.name: Jñānaśrī
persons.evidence: liṣitaṃ ... śrīdharmmachriṃ putra jñānachriṃ thva pariniptasyana saṃpūrṇṇa siddhayakā juro

relations.evidence: dānapati ... turādharavakhāsiṃhayā ... pustaka vāvakā juro ... liṣitaṃ ... jñānachriṃ

date.as_written: samvat 835 vaiśākhamāse śuklapakṣe pañcami pravaṣṭamyān tithau punarvasunakṣatre śūla joge jathākarṇṇamuhūrte budhavāsare

purpose: cāryyopādhyāyas tato pitṛpūrvvagamaṃ kṛtvā śakalasatvarāśīnāmanuttarajñānaphalaṃ prāptam astu
notes: The title 'turādhara' corresponds to Tulādhara. The tithi phrase 'pañcami pravaṣṭamyān' is somewhat ambiguous (possibly pañcamī or aṣṭamī).
